title: Is it worth getting GPT's Pro plan now as opposed to me waiting to finally get Claude's Max plan?
author: Alarming_Scientist
selftext:
Right now Claude's identification is being a two pack of ASS and keeps failing the verification process at the end. Now I'm in a new screen with it wanting two different ID's and i only got one.

  
I've already sent the identification verification form to get some support regarding the issue, but honestly feeling a bit fedup. This is coming after I already completed a month of GPT's pro 200 plan. 

  
Anyone got any recommendations on whether or not I should just bite it and wait for a reply? I Already know what to expect with Codex, but I don't know enough about Claude code. Is Claude Code that good over codex for game making?

comments.author: MelodramaticShape
comments.body: Why don't you have two forms of ID?

replies.author: Alarming_Scientist
replies.body: I don't have a drivers license and i butterfingered hard enough to have pressed the wrong country and now it's asking for Philsys (i am in spain)

replies.author: romansamurai
replies.body: It’s weird to me that passport is not enough of a verification..:that’s the ID of IDs.
